## Riftline / GEMSDOE3

### Outcome

- Preserve the complete pinned upstream source/site/evidence under `legacy/` (large feature parts externalized with hash-verified restoration).
- Autonomously restore canonical data and execute a distinct CPU model comparison, not a renamed inherited prediction.
- Publish a strictly checked float32 GeoTIFF and single-TIFF ZIP with a unique filename and Note.
- Offer prominent browser TIFF generation, independent read-back, an executive submission guide, measured data/source tables and a stale-aware official-source feed.
- Preserve the original user prompt, core values, exact model source, failed-refit evidence, limitations and next steps.

### Required evidence

See `evidence/review.json`, `evidence/pass3-tests.xml`, `evidence/browser-tests.json`, `evidence/browser-validation.json`, `evidence/inference-validation.json` and `provenance/import.json`. Local test results are not GitHub CI results. Actual release status belongs in `evidence/github-access.json` / `evidence/public-deployment.json` and the workflow run.

### Important limitations

No competition upload or new leaderboard score is claimed. The all-data refit failed the predeclared support guard; the unchanged tuning-selected spatial-holdout model is the released candidate. The repeated audit is not independent replication. The raw-feature control had a repeatability irregularity. The feature-only buffer is not a complete pipeline-independence guarantee. Source retrieval failures preserve dated evidence and remain visible. Eligibility and authenticated upload require the entrant’s account.

### Release gate

Run the active Python and Chromium checks. Do not merge failed artifact gates. After merge, verify the actual public page and binary hashes—not just a successful build. Keep all work/pushes on the assigned Arena branch; no automatic branch writes or unreviewed model promotion.
